en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large, elongated farmhouse or inn with a tiled gabled roof and multiple arched windows, set on a gentle hillside with fields and sparse trees. A dirt road runs in front of the house, bordered by simple wooden posts and rails; a man in what looks like an early‑20th‑century uniform and cap walks along the road. A stone-lined ditch or small stream is visible in the foreground, and rolling fields and woodland rise behind the house. There is no obvious caption or decorative postcard frame on the front.
